def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

]:

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def pr(t):
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=pr(t)

import numpy as np
from collections import deque, Counter
i=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 input']); o=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 output'])
bg=Counter(i.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
seeds=[(int(r),int(c),int(i[r][c])) for r,c in zip(*np.where(i!=bg))]
# BFS simultaneous expansion over bg cells; a cell takes color of first seed to reach it.
h,w=i.shape
owners={}  # (r,c)->color
q=deque()
for sr,sc,s in seeds: owners[(sr,sc)]=s; q.append((sr,sc))
while q:
    r,c=q.popleft()
    for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in owners:
            owners[(nr,nc)]=owners[(r,c)]
            q.append((nr,nc))
out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
for (r,c),s in owners.items(): out[r][c]=s
exp=[int(x) for x in i.flatten()]
bad=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c]!=o[r][c])
print('BFS flood mismatches:',bad)
mis=[(r,c,int(o[r][c]),owners.get((r,c))) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
print(mis[:15])
